description: Source code for Abseil's flags usage configuration, including functions for reporting errors, managing usage configurations, and utility functions related to command-line flags.

methods.name: ContainsHelpshortFlags
methods.description: Determines if flags in a filename should be reported with -helpshort flag based on filename pattern.

methods.name: ContainsHelppackageFlags
methods.description: Determines if flags in a filename should be reported with -helppackage flag, currently same as ContainsHelpshortFlags.

methods.name: VersionString
methods.description: Generates version information string for the program.

methods.name: NormalizeFilename
methods.description: Normalizes filename by removing leading slashes.

methods.name: GetUsageConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current usage configuration, initializing defaults if necessary.

methods.name: ReportUsageError
methods.description: Reports a usage error message, optionally terminating the program if fatal.

methods.name: SetFlagsUsageConfig
methods.description: Sets or updates the global flags usage configuration.
